# relix v0.1.4 - Table of Contents

Remote Execution Library for Elixir

## Modules

- [Relix](https://relix.hexdocs.pm/Relix.md): Documentation for `Relix`.

- [Relix.RPC](https://relix.hexdocs.pm/Relix.RPC.md): This module contains a typed struct definition for
holding RPC request related data and some functions
for performing the request and handling its response as well.

- Exceptions
  - [Relix.RPCError](https://relix.hexdocs.pm/Relix.RPCError.md)
